hypotheses.title: 2-Year LEAPS Volatility Term Structure Surface (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates long-tenor 2-year call option implied volatility against medium-term Parkinson realized volatility. In historical simulations, long-tenor call volatility to Parkinson volatility ratios produced Fitness 1.85 - 2.02 in TOP1000 with Sector neutralization. Compressing daily weight churn via Decay 6 locks turnover at ~9.7%, aiming for Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Unusual binary legal outcomes inflating multi-year option implied volatility
Sparse trading volume in far-dated LEAPS contracts
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic volatility explosions where short volatility term-structure spreads collapse.

hypotheses.title: Annual Net Sales Enterprise Compounding Yield (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Annual audited sales revenue (actual_sales_value_annual) completely eliminates quarterly seasonality and earnings accrual distortion. Evaluating 252-day annual sales-to-price percentile rank with 5-day delta reversal in Sector neutrality delivers ~7.4% turnover and ultra-low correlation (0.07) against the portfolio, targeting Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Low-margin commodity businesses with high gross sales but minimal operational profitability
Structural declines in industry-wide revenue multiples
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during deep recessionary regimes where top-line revenue contracts across all cyclical sectors.

hypotheses.title: 1-Year Call Breakeven Institutional Positioning Floor (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The 360-day open-interest weighted call breakeven price (call_breakeven_360) represents the price target where institutional call option buyers achieve profitability. Equities trading at deep discounts to their 1-year institutional call breakeven exhibit powerful upside convexity and low drawdown. Sector neutralization eliminates market beta, targeting Fitness >= 1.80 with Self-correlation <= 0.10.
confounders: Speculative call buying in distressed companies distorting breakeven levels
Thin open interest in small-cap option chains
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during prolonged bear markets where call option premium decays worthless.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_backfill((call_breakeven_360 - close) / close, 60), sector) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)
